name: Snap CourtYard
description: Snap two footprint courtyards corner-to-corner or edge-to-edge.
description_full: PCB editor IPC plugin (KiCad 9+). Select 2+ footprints and snap their courtyard bounding boxes together — Edge-to-Edge or Corner-to-Corner. Features: live PCB preview while the dialog is open, chain snapping for 3+ footprints in selection order, Shift+click toolbar to repeat last config silently, persistent settings, optional dx/dy offset. Uses the KiCad IPC API (kicad-python); no deprecated SWIG bindings. Rotation preserved; only translation applied.
